claims.text: Hutton Hotel is in the heart of Midtown Nashville.

findings.quote: Hutton Hotel is a creative retreat in the heart of Midtown Nashville.

claims.text: The hotel's address is 1808 West End Avenue, Nashville.

findings.quote: 1808 West End Ave., Nashville, Tennessee 37203

claims.text: The hotel is designed with real artists in mind: what they need, how they create and how they really live.

findings.quote: It’s an environment intentionally designed with real artists in mind—what they need, how they create, and the way they really live.

claims.text: The hotel's art collection highlights emerging and established talent, local and beyond.

findings.quote: Our collection highlights emerging and established talent—local and beyond—and brings warmth, texture, and meaning to every space.

claims.text: The hotel's common spaces often host pop-up performances and impromptu sets.

findings.quote: Our common spaces often turn into something less expected—pop-up performances, impromptu sets

claims.text: Rooms have a Marshall Acton III Bluetooth speaker and a Dyson Supersonic hairdryer.

findings.quote:
- Dyson Supersonic™ hairdryer
- Marshall Acton III Bluetooth Speaker

claims.text: The Superior King room has a dedicated in-room workout area and a wellness basket with a yoga mat, dumbbells and a foam roller.

findings.quote: The Superior King Guestroom features a larger layout with a dedicated in-room workout area and wellness basket including a yoga mat, dumbbells, and foam roller.

claims.text: Penthouse East has a private south-facing balcony, a kitchenette, dining for six and a marble fireplace.

findings.quote: this one-bedroom penthouse features a private south-facing balcony, kitchenette, and dining for six. A marble fireplace anchors the living space

claims.text: Mimi's Lobby Bar serves coffee and pastries by day and becomes a neighborhood bar with craft cocktails by night.

findings.quote: By day, Mimi's is your go-to for coffee and pastries worth slowing down for. By night, it transforms into a neighborhood bar with craft cocktails and easy charm.

claims.text: The fitness center has high-performance equipment and natural light.

findings.quote: featuring high-performance equipment, natural light, and a calm, focused atmosphere

claims.text: The hotel offers pet-friendly rooms.

findings.quote: ### Pet-Friendly Rooms

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls the Hutton Nashville's original boutique hotel.

findings.quote: Nashville's original boutique hotel

claims.text: Analog is the hotel's in-house live music venue, intimate, acoustically dialed-in and designed to honor live performance.

findings.quote: Analog offers a rare kind of in-house entertainment—intimate, acoustically dialed-in, and intentionally designed to honor live performance.
From our stage to our studios, we’ve created intimate spaces where music is written, recorded, performed, and shared.

claims.text: The hotel has Writers' Studios with professional-grade gear, a nod to the city's songwriting legacy.

findings.quote: Our Writers’ Studios are built for when inspiration hits. With professional-grade gear, they’re a quiet nod to the songwriting legacy that defines this city.

claims.text: Room stays include Fender Play, a vinyl library and a 20% discount on shows at Analog.

findings.quote:
- 20% Discount on Shows at Analog
- Fender Play
- Vinyl Library

claims.text: The Hutton Suite is a two-level, three-bedroom residence with a chef's kitchen, a dining room and a dedicated writing room.

findings.quote: A two-level, three-bedroom residence featuring a chef’s kitchen, dining room, en suite bathrooms with European-style showers, and a dedicated writing room

claims.text: At Evelyn's, the hotel's Modern Americana restaurant, beloved Southern classics find a fresh perspective.

findings.quote: ## Modern Americana, Rooted in nashville
At Evelyn's, beloved Southern classics find fresh perspective.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the rooms are not large, though smartly designed.

findings.quote: Rooms definitely aren't large, but they're so smartly designed, you won't necessarily mind that you sacrificed on space.

claims.text: The spa's sauna, cold plunge and salt room are complimentary with a scheduled treatment, and time in them must be reserved by calling once the appointment is booked.
